summary: Multi-chassis link aggregation joins a group of independent nodes into one logical connection. This RFC defines an EVPN port-active redundancy mode, where only one of the redundant ports is active at a time, giving a simple load-balancing and redundancy option building on RFC 7432.

eli5.summary: Two doors lead to a room, but only one is open at a time. If it gets blocked, the other opens. This is that arrangement for network links.
